questions.en: The atmospheric pressure at sea level is measured by which instrument?
questions.hi: समुद्र तल पर वायुमंडलीय दबाव को किस उपकरण द्वारा मापा जाता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Atmospheric pressure is measured by a mercury or aneroid barometer, invented by Evangelista Torricelli in 1643. Standard atmospheric pressure is 760 mm of Hg (1 atm = 101.3 kPa).
questions.tip: Instruments guide: Barometer = Atmospheric pressure; Hygrometer = Relative humidity; Hydrometer = Specific gravity of liquids.

questions.en: Which blood group in humans is recognized as the 'Universal Recipient'?(
questions.hi: मानवों में किस रक्त समूह को 'सर्वग्राही' (Universal Recipient) कहा जाता है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Blood group AB positive (AB+) contains both A and B antigens on RBCs and the Rh factor, with no anti-A, anti-B, or anti-Rh antibodies in serum, allowing it to safely receive all blood types.
questions.tip: Universal Donor = O negative (O-); Universal Recipient = AB positive (AB+).

questions.en: Which vitamin is synthesized endogenously in the human body upon exposure to sunlight?
questions.hi: सूर्य के प्रकाश के संपर्क में आने पर मानव शरीर में किस विटामिन का संश्लेषण होता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: UV-B radiation in sunlight converts 7-dehydrocholesterol in the epidermal layer of the skin into cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3), essential for calcium homeostasis.
questions.tip: Vitamin D deficiency causes Rickets in children and Osteomalacia in adults.

questions.en: In an aquatic ecosystem (such as a pond or deep lake), the pyramid of biomass is typically(
questions.hi: एक जलीय पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (जैसे तालाब या गहरी झील) में जैव-भार (बायोमास) का पिरामिड प्रायः होता है)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In aquatic ecosystems, the standing biomass of primary producers (microscopic phytoplankton) at any given moment is far smaller than the biomass of long-lived zooplankton and predatory fish that consume them, resulting in an inverted pyramid of biomass.
questions.tip: Pyramid of energy is ALWAYS upright in all ecosystems. Pyramid of biomass is inverted in aquatic/oceanic ecosystems and upright in terrestrial/forest ecosystems.

questions.en: In the human digestive system, bile juice is synthesized in which organ and where is it stored temporarily?(
questions.hi: मानव पाचन तंत्र में पित्त रस (Bile) का निर्माण किस अंग में होता है और इसका भंडारण कहाँ होता है?)
options: Synthesized in Pancreas, stored in Liver
Synthesized in Liver, stored in Gallbladder
Synthesized in Stomach, stored in Small Intestine
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: Synthesized in Liver, stored in Gallbladder
questions.explanation: Bile juice is synthesized continuously by hepatic cells of the liver and concentrated/stored in the gallbladder. It contains no digestive enzymes but contains bile salts that emulsify dietary fats.
questions.tip: Classic trap: Liver produces bile; Gallbladder only stores and concentrates it.
options_hi: Synthesized in अग्न्याशय, stored in यकृत (लीवर)
Synthesized in यकृत (लीवर), stored in Gallbladder
Synthesized in आमाशय (पेट), stored in छोटी आंत

questions.explanation_hi: Bile juice is synthesized continuously by hepatic cells of the यकृत (लीवर) and concentrated/stored in the gallbladder. It contains no digestive enzymes but contains bile salts that emulsify dietary fats.
questions.tip_hi: Classic trap: यकृत (लीवर) produces bile; Gallbladder only stores and concentrates it.

questions.en: Which of the following optical phenomena is fundamentally responsible for the formation of a rainbow in the sky?
questions.hi: आकाश में इन्द्रधनुष के निर्माण के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी प्रकाशिक घटनाएँ उत्तरदायी हैं?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Rainbow formation involves refraction and dispersion of sunlight as it enters water droplets, followed by total internal reflection at the back of the droplet, and refraction again as it exits.
questions.tip: Three-stage optical process: Refraction -> Dispersion -> Total Internal Reflection.
options_hi: अपवर्तन, वर्ण विक्षेपण, and Internal परावर्तन
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.tip_hi: Three-stage optical process: अपवर्तन -> वर्ण विक्षेपण -> पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन.

options: More than one of the above

questions.en: In the human circulatory system, which blood vessels carry oxygenated blood from the lungs back to the left atrium of the heart?(
questions.hi: मानव परिसंचरण तंत्र में फेफड़ों से शुद्ध (ऑक्सीजनयुक्त) रक्त हृदय के बाएं अलिंद में लाने वाली रक्त वाहिकाएँ कौन-सी हैं?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Generally, arteries carry oxygenated blood and veins carry deoxygenated blood. The exceptions are pulmonary blood vessels: Pulmonary artery carries deoxygenated blood to lungs, while pulmonary veins carry oxygenated blood from lungs to left atrium.
questions.tip: Exception to vein rule: Pulmonary veins carry oxygen-rich blood.

questions.en: The brilliant sparkling brilliance of diamond is primarily attributable to which physical phenomenon?
questions.hi: हीरे की अत्यधिक चमक मुख्यतः किस भौतिक परिघटना के कारण होती है?
options: Total Internal Reflection with a very small critical angle
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: Total Internal Reflection with a very small critical angle
questions.explanation: Diamond has a very high refractive index (2.42), which results in an exceptionally small critical angle of approximately 24.4°. Light entering a properly cut diamond undergoes multiple total internal reflections before emerging.
questions.tip: Diamond brilliance = Total Internal Reflection (TIR) + high refractive index (2.42).
options_hi: पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन with a very small critical angle
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.tip_hi: Diamond brilliance = पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन (TIR) + high refractive index (2.42).

questions.en: Which cellular components of human blood are primarily responsible for blood clotting (coagulation) at the site of a wound?(
questions.hi: मानव रक्त का कौन-सा कोशिकीय घटक घाव लगने पर रक्त का थक्का (Coagulation) जमाने के लिए मुख्य रूप से उत्तरदायी है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Blood platelets (thrombocytes) release thromboplastin, which initiates a cascade converting prothrombin into thrombin in the presence of calcium ions, ultimately forming a fibrin mesh that stops bleeding.
questions.tip: Clotting cells = Platelets (Thrombocytes); Oxygen transport = RBCs; Immunity = WBCs; Clotting vitamin = Vitamin K.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Blood प्लेटलेट्स (रक्त बिम्बाणु) (thrombocytes) release thromboplastin, which initiates a cascade converting prothrombin into thrombin in the presence of calcium ions, ultimately forming a fibrin mesh that stops bleeding.
questions.tip_hi: Clotting cells = प्लेटलेट्स (रक्त बिम्बाणु) (Thrombocytes); Oxygen transport = RBCs; Immunity = WBCs; Clotting vitamin = Vitamin K.

questions.en: Which synthetic fibre is prepared by the chemical treatment of natural wood pulp and is popularly known as 'Artificial Silk'?(
questions.hi: प्राकृतिक काष्ठ की लुगदी के रासायनिक उपचार से तैयार किए जाने वाले किस कृत्रिम रेशे को 'कृत्रिम रेशम' (Artificial Silk) कहा जाता है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Rayon is a regenerated cellulosic fibre manufactured from purified wood pulp chemically treated with carbon disulfide and sodium hydroxide. It possesses a lustrous silk-like appearance and soft texture.
questions.tip: Artificial Silk = Rayon (from wood pulp); First fully synthetic fibre = Nylon.

questions.en: Which blood group is universally known as the 'Universal Donor' because its red blood cells lack both A and B surface antigens?(

questions.tip: Universal Donor = O Negative (O-); Universal Recipient = AB Positive (AB+).

questions.en: Which international treaty, signed in 1987, was successfully designed to phase out the production and consumption of chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) to protect the stratospheric ozone layer?(1987
questions.hi: में हस्ताक्षरित कौन-सी अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संधि समतापमंडलीय ओजोन परत के संरक्षण हेतु क्लोरोफ्लोरोकार्बन (CFCs) के उत्पादन को समाप्त करने के लिए तैयार की गई थी?)

questions.explanation: The Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer was agreed on 16 September 1987 (commemorated globally as World Ozone Day) and came into force in 1989, successfully phasing out 99% of ozone-depleting substances.
questions.tip: Ozone Layer protection = Montreal Protocol (1987); Greenhouse Gas reduction = Kyoto Protocol (1997).

questions.en: What is the main ore of aluminium extracted industrially through the Bayer process?
questions.hi: बेयर प्रक्रम द्वारा औद्योगिक रूप से निष्कर्षित एल्युमिनियम का मुख्य अयस्क कौन-सा है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bauxite (Al2O3 · 2H2O) is the principal aluminium ore. In the Bayer process, bauxite is digested in hot sodium hydroxide to produce pure alumina, which is then electrolyzed in the Hall-Héroult cell to produce metallic aluminium.

questions.en: Which green pigment in chloroplasts absorbs solar light energy during photosynthesis?
questions.hi: प्रकाश संश्लेषण के दौरान सौर प्रकाश ऊर्जा को अवशोषित करने वाला हरित लवक में मौजूद वर्णक कौन-सा है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll (predominantly Chlorophyll a and b) contains a magnesium porphyrin ring and absorbs light mainly in the blue and red wavelengths of the visible spectrum while reflecting green light.
questions.tip: Photosynthetic green pigment = Chlorophyll (central metal atom = Magnesium, Mg).

questions.en: Statements: All petals are flowers. All flowers are plants.Conclusions: I. All petals are plants. II. Some plants are petals.
questions.hi: कथन: सभी पंखुड़ियाँ फूल हैं। सभी फूल पौधे हैं।निष्कर्ष: I. सभी पंखुड़ियाँ पौधे हैं। II. कुछ पौधे पंखुड़ियाँ हैं।
options: Both conclusion I and II follow
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: Both conclusion I and II follow
questions.explanation: Universal affirmative premise: Petals ⊂ Flowers ⊂ Plants. Therefore, Petals ⊂ Plants (Conclusion I holds). Since Petals are a subset of Plants, some plants are definitely petals (Conclusion II holds).
questions.tip: Concentric circles: Petals inside Flowers inside Plants => Both I and II definitely follow.

questions.en: Deficiency of dietary iodine leads to the enlargement of which endocrine gland, causing the condition known as simple goitre?(
questions.hi: आहार में आयोडीन की कमी से किस अन्तःस्रावी ग्रंथि का आकार असामान्य रूप से बढ़ जाता है, जिसे घेंघा (Goitre) रोग कहते हैं?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Iodine is essential for the synthesis of thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3) by the thyroid gland. Iodine deficiency stimulates excessive TSH release, causing hyperplasia and enlargement of the thyroid gland (goitre).
questions.tip: Goitre = Thyroid Gland enlargement (Iodine deficiency); Hormone = Thyroxine.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Iodine is essential for the synthesis of thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3) by the थायरॉयड ग्रंथि gland. Iodine deficiency stimulates excessive TSH release, causing hyperplasia and enlargement of the थायरॉयड ग्रंथि gland (goitre).
questions.tip_hi: Goitre = थायरॉयड ग्रंथि Gland enlargement (Iodine deficiency); Hormone = Thyroxine.

questions.en: Which of the following greenhouse gases is released extensively from submerged agricultural paddy fields and enteric fermentation in cattle?
questions.hi: जलमग्न धान के खेतों और मवेशियों के पाचन से कौन-सी ग्रीनहाउस गैस अत्यधिक मात्रा में उत्सर्जित होती है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Methanogenic archaebacteria operating in anaerobic conditions of waterlogged rice paddies and the rumen of ruminant livestock produce massive quantities of biogenic methane (CH4), a potent greenhouse gas.
questions.tip: Paddy fields & cattle belching = Methane (CH4); Coal mines & marsh gas = Methane.

questions.tip_hi: Paddy fields & cattle belching = मीथेन (CH4); Coal mines & marsh gas = मीथेन.

questions.en: Winter rainfall in the plains of Northwest India and parts of Bihar is primarily caused by which meteorological system?
questions.hi: उत्तर-पश्चिम भारत के मैदानों और बिहार के कुछ हिस्सों में सर्दियों की वर्षा मुख्य रूप से किस मौसम प्रणाली के कारण होती है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Western disturbances are extra-tropical cyclonic storms originating over the Mediterranean Sea and steered eastward by the subtropical westerly jet stream. They bring crucial winter rain (Mahawat) beneficial for Rabi crops (wheat).
questions.tip: Northwest India winter rain = Western Disturbances; Coromandel (Tamil Nadu) coast winter rain = Retreating Monsoon.

questions.en: Black soil (Regur soil) in India is most extensively developed over which geological region and is uniquely suited for the cultivation of which commercial crop?(
questions.hi: भारत में काली मिट्टी (रेगुर मिट्टी) का विस्तार मुख्यतः किस भू-भाग पर है और यह किस व्यावसायिक फसल के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Regur (black cotton soil) is derived from the weathering of basaltic Deccan trap lava rocks (Maharashtra, Gujarat, MP). It is rich in clay, possesses high moisture retention capacity, and is ideal for cotton cultivation.
questions.tip: Black Soil = Regur = Basaltic lava = Cotton cultivation.

questions.en: Dalmianagar, situated along the Son River in Rohtas district of Bihar, emerged historically as a premier industrial centre for which industries?
questions.hi: बिहार के रोहतास जिले में सोन नदी के तट पर स्थित डालमियानगर ऐतिहासिक रूप से किन उद्योगों के प्रमुख केंद्र के रूप में उभरा था?
options: Cement, Sugar, Paper, and Chemical manufacturing
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: Cement, Sugar, Paper, and Chemical manufacturing
questions.explanation: Established by Ramkrishna Dalmia under the Rohtas Industries conglomerate in the 1930s, Dalmianagar was one of India's largest integrated industrial complexes, housing cement plants, sugar mills, paper factories, and chemical works.
questions.tip: Dalmianagar (Rohtas) = Cement, Paper, Sugar, Chemicals; Barauni (Begusarai) = Oil Refinery, Fertilizer.

questions.en: Which chemical compound is responsible for the yellow colour of human urine?
questions.hi: मानव मूत्र का पीला रंग किस यौगिक की उपस्थिति के कारण होता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The pale yellow colour of normal urine is due to the pigment urochrome (urobilin), a breakdown end-product of hemoglobin degradation excreted by the kidneys.
questions.tip: Urine yellow pigment = Urochrome; Bile yellow pigment = Bilirubin.
